recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Cosmic Womb and the Living Matrix", "body": "Chance opened by saying the larger reality we are returning to is the cosmic womb or cosmic egg, and he pointed out that a womb is a matrix. Jenny said she had never connected the living matrix with a womb and that she would be chewing on the idea of wombs within wombs. Later Chance described life as fractal, with life force energy expressing itself similarly across scale, and he linked that to rings in a tree, the tree of life and the cosmic egg model."}, {"title": "Reptilians, Serpents, and Hosts of Energy", "body": "Chance said he had been reluctant to look at reptilians until he read Pierre Sabak, whose polyglottal puns he described as linking words for serpents, watchers, angels and sailors. Chance wondered whether serpent beings might be energy columns like a spine, and he called bodies hosts for life force. Jenny said she knew little about lizard people but felt they would be part of the oneness. Michael wondered who designed the blind spot in human consciousness and said the reptilian narrative might fit there."}, {"title": "Demons, Division, and Inner Integration", "body": "Chance argued that demonic means two or divided, and that compartmentalized energy creates stagnation. Michael recounted a friend's view that opening chakras can invite demonic activity, comparing it to leaving windows down in a parked car. Jenny disagreed with treating demons as outsiders, saying the dark forces live within us too, and she tied the serpent to the demonized feminine. Chance added that inner alchemy meant putting the pieces of yourself back where they belong, and the group joked about a thank your demon day."}, {"title": "The Moon, the Sun, and Seeing Differently", "body": "Michael said he did not know what the moon was, and he argued that the value lay in putting attention on something outside the closed loop system of culture. He described the new moon as the moon and sun rising together, and the full moon as the opposite. Chance relayed Benjamin Balderson's view of the earth, sun and moon as a galvanic cell with a masculine Luna and a feminine Sol. Jenny described watching old beliefs fall away, and Chance noted that many cultures treated the moon as masculine."}, {"title": "Mythology, Stories, and Creating Your Own System", "body": "Rachel asked how much stock to put in astrological mythology, and Jenny answered that she and Michael were moving into a post lineage space. Michael described what he called objective astrology, treating the natal chart as a time marker. Chance said mythology may have encoded an alchemical process but warned against attachment to stories, and Jenny added that the story and the mystery can both be honored. Michael and Jenny later described their starboard and an upcoming star quilt, urging listeners to make their own."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Syncromystic sage Michael Wann and energy healer Jenny Rivers join us on Vibe Rant tonight to talk about the Living Matrix (the eternal womb), and how to make room in our energy fields for the expanding of Life Force.
